title: Snap
description: Detailed information about a single snap.

id.description: The unique identifier for the snap.

base.description: The base snap this snap is built on.

channel.description: The default channel for this snap.

contact.description: The primary contact URL or email for the developer.

description.description: A detailed description of the snap.

developer.description: The username of the snap developer.

devmode.description:
If set to true, the snap needs to be installed with devmode confinement
and doesn't, yet, work with strict confinement due to sandbox limitations
or developer unfamiliarity.

download-size.description: The size of the snap package in bytes.

icon.description: A URL to the snap's icon image.

revision.description: The latest revision number of the snap in this channel.

store-url.description: The URL to the snap's page in the Snap Store.

summary.description: A short, one-line summary of the snap.

type.description:
The type of the snap. 'os' is deprecated, and is left for compatibility
with the 'core' and 'ubuntu-core' snaps.

version.description: The version string of the latest revision.

website.description: The official website for the snap or application.

Links.description: A collection of relevant links for the snap.

additionalProperties.description: Allows for other link collections like 'issues', 'docs', etc.

Media.description: A media asset for the snap, such as an icon or screenshot.

height.description: The height of the asset in pixels.

width.description: The width of the asset in pixels.

Publisher.description: Information about the publisher of the snap.

display-name.description: The user name associated with the account.

id.description: The developer ID associated with the account.

StoreCategory.description: A store category associated with the snap.

featured.description: Indicates if the snap is featured in this category.
